matters.name: Kasarani Foods v. Tumaini Traders
matters.stands: The hearing in Kasarani Foods v. Tumaini Traders is due on Thursday 12 November, and David has it. Nothing is in the way that has not been cleared.

wanjiruOnTuesday.question: Are the fee notes being paid, and why not where they aren’t?
wanjiruOnTuesday.answer: 21% of what’s due is paid, on proof. A further KES 120,000 is paid on somebody’s word, with no proof yet. One fee note is behind, but the client is in touch.
wanjiruOnTuesday.answerFrom: Payments count as proven where a bank slip, an M-Pesa message or the accounting system’s record is filed on the fee note; everything else is from what people said in their check-ins.

rows.title: Jamii Clinics missed the date they promised to pay by
rows.says: Fee note FN-007 for Jamii Clinics, KES 180,000. The client promised to pay by 10 October, and nothing has come in. Aisha follows it up.

rows.title: Fee note FN-005 for Kasarani Foods fell due on 20 October
rows.says: It falls due when the reply is filed. Brian said in Litigation team daily on 20 October, “In Kasarani Foods v. Tumaini Traders, the reply was filed on 20 October.” It is for KES 250,000, and nothing is paid yet. Brian follows it up.

rows.title: Upendo Schools has not been heard from
rows.says: Fee note FN-009 for Upendo Schools, KES 300,000, fell due on 1 September. Nobody has heard from the client since. Aisha follows it up.

rows.title: Nyota Logistics disputes fee note FN-008
rows.says: Fee note FN-008 for Nyota Logistics, KES 90,000. Brian said, “The client says the review was billed twice.” Brian follows it up.

rows.title: Baraka Hardware’s payment has no proof yet
rows.says: Aisha says fee note FN-006 for Baraka Hardware is paid. A bank slip, an M-Pesa message or the accounting system’s record would show it.

rows.title: A fee note for Kasarani Foods is not raised yet
rows.says: It falls due when the hearing date is set. It is for KES 250,000. Brian follows it up.

toConfirm.title: Did the fee note for Kasarani Foods that is not raised yet fall due on 20 October?
toConfirm.says: It falls due when the hearing date is set. David said in Litigation team daily on 20 October, “Kasarani Foods: the mention date is set for 3 November.” Groundwork cannot tell whether this is the same event, so nothing has changed.
